about: drawn after Seeed Studio's photos of the reBot Arm B601-RS gripper (the Seeed wiki's B601-RS guides: the arm at its zero pose, rs_0pos, and the gripper over a test-tube rack, 00-task-overview-rs-en; 2026-11-17) and its bill of materials (reBot-DevArm's hardware README: the fingers printed in black ABS, the rail supports and end stops in green PLA, the bracket, slider extensions and racks CNC-machined aluminium 5052, anodised or sandblasted, an MGN9 rail): the black printed fingers on their slider blocks, the bead-blasted aluminium of the bracket plate and the slider extensions, the ground steel rail, the lime-green printed supports, and the gripper's RS-00 actuator, a black can.  The actuator is the project's own drawing, not the model's file: plain cylinders and boxes to the sizes of the model's motor_7 (its can 57 mm across and 52 mm long on a 63 mm base ring 15 mm long, its two plug housings), whose 26 480 triangles keep 20 629 within 0.5 mm, 1.03 MB, over the Library's budget for the bodies (bodies/seeed-rebot/drawn-motor-can.stl, drawn-motor-base.stl and drawn-motor-plugs.stl).  The fingers' carriages are the part's own black; the screws and the cables are not drawn.

abs-black.evidence: rs_0pos and 00-task-overview-rs-en: the printed fingers are an even matte black with layer lines and no highlight, #454545 on the slotted outer face under the room's light and #313131 on its shaded side (#333535 in the studio photo); the bill of materials prints them in black ABS

pla-lime.evidence: rs_0pos: the printed supports and end stops are a light yellow-green, #c7d54a at the median of the lit front block and #d8e24e on its top (white-balanced on the wall behind; the studio photo's teal light draws them #94c35a), a matte print with no sheen; the model's own lime is #b8d933

alu-blasted.evidence: 00-task-overview-rs-en: the bracket's plate and the slider extensions are bead-blasted aluminium, a soft grey satin (#8a8d8a lit, #4f544f in shade, a bright line on each machined edge), duller than a milled face; the bill of materials says aluminium 5052, anodised or sandblasted

rail-steel.evidence: the bill of materials' MGN9-170 rail, ground steel, which Seeed's own render of the arm (the repository's RS5_56) draws as the gripper's brightest metal between the lime supports; less of the room than the base, as the other grippers' rails, so that its flat top, mirroring one patch of the room whole, is not the card's white

motor-black.evidence: rs_0pos and 00-task-overview-rs-en: the RS-00 actuator behind the bracket is a matte black can (#1c1c1c to #24201f under the room's light) with one broad soft highlight, as the Unitree Dex1's can
